struct Reading { label: Str, values: Vec<Int> }

fn largest(v: Vec<Int>) -> Int {
    let mut max = -1
    for x in v {
        if x > max {
            max = x
        }
    }
    max
}

fn second_largest(v: Vec<Int>) -> Option<Int> {
    let mut first = -1
    let mut second = -1
    for x in v {
        if x > first {
            second = first
            first = x
        } else if x > second {
            second = x
        }
    }
    if second == -1 {
        None
    } else {
        Some(second)
    }
}
